frozen_note: Lista definida ANTES de coletar ou ver qualquer anúncio do teste cego. Não pode ser alterada depois.

types.treadmill: full-size electric treadmill with console and side handrails, running speeds
types.walking_pad: compact low-profile walking treadmill, flat deck, walking speeds, under-desk, no console tower
types.spin_bike: upright indoor cycling / spinning bike with heavy flywheel
types.upright_bike: upright stationary exercise bike or folding X-bike that is not a spinning bike
types.recumbent_bike: recumbent exercise bike with backrest seat
types.air_bike: fan / air resistance bike with moving arms
types.stair_climber: stepper, mini stepper or stair climber machine
types.adjustable_dumbbell: dumbbell whose weight can be changed (selector, removable plates, spin-lock)
types.fixed_dumbbell: fixed-weight dumbbell (hex, round, neoprene, vinyl, chrome)
types.barbell: barbell bar, EZ bar or fixed barbell
types.weight_bench: flat, adjustable or folding workout bench
types.power_rack: power rack, squat rack, squat stand or cage
types.home_gym_station: multi-station home gym / cable machine / smith machine
types.pull_up_bar: doorway or wall-mounted pull-up / chin-up bar
types.resistance_band: elastic resistance bands, loops or tubes
types.foam_roller: foam roller or massage roller stick
types.gym_accessory: small training accessory not listed above (gloves, straps, belts, collars, grips, bottles)

flags.is_accessory_or_part: listing sells a part, accessory, spare or cover FOR a machine (e.g. treadmill belt, lubricant, remote, cover, safety key), not the machine itself
flags.is_kit_or_bundle: listing sells several different products together
flags.has_variations: listing offers several weights, sizes or models to choose from
